address: 4 Lothian Road, Edinburgh, EH1 2AB, United Kingdom
bio: The Pompadour is one of the city’s most famous restaurant names and it sits within one of its best-known hotels, The Caledonian – if you’re lucky, you may get one of the tables that look up to the castle. The tasting menu makes creative use of prime Scottish produce but with a noticeable Asian influence; contrasts in flavours, textures and temperatures all feature....
